description: Influences how your body breaks down alcohol; certain versions cause facial flushing and discomfort after drinking
Affects muscle fiber type and power; some variants are linked to sprint strength while others favor endurance
Affects blood clotting; certain variants increase the risk of forming dangerous blood clots
Plays a role in processing folate (vitamin B9); some variants reduce efficiency and can affect homocysteine levels
Influences how the brain responds to pain and pleasure; some variants are linked to stronger responses to opioids or alcohol
Determines whether you can digest lactose as an adult; some variants allow continued milk digestion
One version of this gene is linked to a higher risk of Alzheimer’s disease and heart disease later in life
Works together with other APOE variants to influence Alzheimer’s disease risk, including protective forms
Involved in iron absorption; some variants can cause the body to store too much iron
Affects lung and liver protection; certain rare variants can increase the risk of lung or liver disease
Influences how quickly alcohol is broken down; faster breakdown can reduce heavy drinking risk
Plays a role in protecting cells from oxidative damage caused by normal metabolism and environmental stress
Involved in immune and inflammatory responses; some variants are linked to higher inflammation levels
Affects how the body responds to stress hormones and certain asthma medications
Influences skin and hair pigmentation; some variants increase sun sensitivity and skin cancer risk
Plays a role in breaking down drugs, alcohol, and environmental toxins in the liver
Affects muscle energy use during exercise; some variants are linked to quicker fatigue during intense activity
